definitions.case_composition_unit: one designed case across both agents and all three trials (12 total)
definitions.composition: exclusive: all_pass/all_fail require every eligible check observed and identical status; disagreement requires fully observed mixed pass/fail; any nonobservation makes indeterminate
definitions.correctness: unweighted passed eligible checks / effectively observed eligible checks; null for no observations
definitions.effective: pass/fail with category != invalid_response; memory/format domains excluded from ability gate
definitions.interpretation: descriptive preregistered project thresholds, not a statistical significance test or proof of construct validity
definitions.mean_drop: mean of three pooled trial low-minus-high correctness differences; null if any trial is unobserved
definitions.pooled_family_trial: pool both agents equally at the predeclared check-count level per family/level/trial
definitions.stable_difference: same strict agent-correctness difference direction in at least two of three trials, pooling low/high; not significance

warnings: Fewer than three families meet the descriptive difficulty-effect gate; difficulty sufficiency is unproven.
Observed family differences are conditional on this dataset/configuration and are not a general agent ranking.
Effective-only correctness can be selection-biased; always inspect per-level coverage and nonobservation causes.
